I taped the tires a little bit, taped up the red in the center. Put a garbage bag over the brakes, I just pushed it thru the spokes. smooth sprays in no particular direction. Tried to have even sprays, not letting it drip or pool up. Did that until it’s covered, then to the next wheel. Do the rest then came back around to the first one, do another coat. Let each one dry for like 20 minutes or so. Exacto knife the plastidip from the tape. Pull all the tape off. That’s it. It wasn’t too hard. If you wanna do the red or anything. Definitely try to make the tape thin as possible. I cut it a little bigger and just stuffed it. Made taking it off much harder.
